bullets.text: The Greater Chennai Corporation reviewed stormwater drainage and canal works in Adyar and Sholinganallur zones, including the Okkiyam Maduvu Canal, to improve flood readiness.
Karambakkam residents questioned the construction of a PDS shop on a pond site, and the office should watch for the GCC and revenue department clarification.
A court ordered 1.70 crore rupees in compensation for a Pallikaranai woman who went into a coma after an accident.
Collector Kavitha announced that 134 government buses are operated in Thiruvallur under the Chief Minister's Vetri Payanam scheme.
Thiruvallur Collector Kavitha announced that people can lodge complaints if there are quantity discrepancies in items provided at ration shops.
Motorists faced hardship due to overgrown thorny bushes along the Ponneri-Perumbedu highway, and the office should monitor clearance.
The PanIIT AP Summit 2026 in Vijayawada will spotlight DeepTech, AI, and innovation with discussions on quantum computing and investments.
Soumya Anbumani stated they will exert pressure to gradually reduce liquor shops to create a liquor-free state.
GK Vasan stated that TVK has high chances of winning the by-elections for the Dharapuram and Madurantakam assembly constituencies.
Prime Minister Modi will visit Chennai on the 11th to launch the Poonamallee to Vadapalani metro rail service.
Minister Ranjithkumar launched the Vetri Payanam scheme in Kancheepuram municipal corporation.

stories.title: Okkiyam Maduvu Canal Widening Improves Chennai Flood Readiness
takeaways: The Greater Chennai Corporation reviewed monsoon flood preparedness works along the Okkiyam Maduvu Canal in Adyar.
Officials inspected canal widening and drainage infrastructure to prevent seasonal flooding in south Chennai zones.
stories.snippet: The Greater Chennai Corporation has reviewed stormwater drainage and canal works in Adyar and Sholinganallur zones, including the widening of the Okkiyam Maduvu Canal, as the city prepares for the Northeast monsoon.…
